# Credit Appraisal and Loan Review Action Items

This document details key action items for the Credit & Loans department:

*   Review the collateral value standard update.
*   Investigate borrower credit scores based on audit findings.
*   Urgently investigate borrower credit scores.
*   Investigate interest rates on a quarterly basis.
*   Urgently update collateral values.
